"""
	Build the reports dataset from registerhistory.

	Three separate queries:
	  1. Cycles active in period + their REAL latest status (no time filter on status)
	  2. Type-10 signature records for those cycles
	  3. Supervisor name from form field (papoitem 'Supervisor')

	Version: 5.0.0

	Args:
		value (dict): Struct with db, startDate, endDate, supervisor

	Returns:
		list[dict]: Report rows for table consumption

	Changelog:
		2026-10-22 | William M. | v5.0.0 - Cycle key includes WorkstationNodeID
			(stations sharing a node no longer mix); supervisor question resolved
			through MasterPapoID; supervisor filter (normalized full name) and
			counters applied here; no refresh tick (re-query only on filter change);
			supervisor options = supervisors with reports in the period; latest
			start-form answer wins
		2026-09-01 | Andres G. | v4.0.0 - Add supervisor from form field;
			OperadorEsperado/SupervisorEsperado as row fields, not custom props;
			Cierre Automatico detection for sinFirmaOperario counter
	"""
	logger = system.util.getLogger("transform.dataReports.{}".format(self.view.id))

	db = value["db"]
	startDate = value["startDate"]
	endDate = value["endDate"]
	supervisorFilter = value.get("supervisor")

	try:
		# --- Query 1: cycles active in period + REAL latest status ---
		queryCycles = """
			WITH activeCycles AS (
				SELECT DISTINCT
					rh.NodeID,
					rh.PapoID,
					rh.WorkstationNodeID,
					rh.RegisterCode
				FROM registerhistory rh
				WHERE rh.RegisterTypeID NOT IN (10, 12)
				  AND rh.Timestamp >= ?
				  AND rh.Timestamp <= ?
			),
			fullCycles AS (
				SELECT
					ac.NodeID, ac.PapoID, ac.WorkstationNodeID, ac.RegisterCode,
					MAX(rh.ID) AS lastID,
					MAX(CASE WHEN rh.RegisterTypeID = 7 THEN rh.Timestamp END) AS startTime
				FROM activeCycles ac
				JOIN registerhistory rh
					ON rh.NodeID = ac.NodeID
					AND rh.PapoID = ac.PapoID
					AND rh.WorkstationNodeID = ac.WorkstationNodeID
					AND rh.RegisterCode = ac.RegisterCode
				WHERE rh.RegisterTypeID != 12
				GROUP BY ac.NodeID, ac.PapoID, ac.WorkstationNodeID, ac.RegisterCode
			)
			SELECT
				fc.NodeID, fc.PapoID, fc.RegisterCode,
				fc.startTime,
				rh.Status, rh.Timestamp, rh.[User],
				rh.WorkstationNodeID, rh.WorkstationID,
				p.Reference AS PapoReference,
				p.Description AS PapoDescription,
				n.Name AS NodeName,
				n.Topic AS Path,
				w.Description AS WorkstationDescription
			FROM fullCycles fc
			JOIN registerhistory rh ON rh.ID = fc.lastID
			JOIN papo p ON p.ID = fc.PapoID
			JOIN node n ON n.ID = fc.NodeID
			LEFT JOIN workstation w ON w.ID = rh.WorkstationID
			WHERE LOWER(rh.Status) != 'sin iniciar'
			ORDER BY rh.Timestamp DESC
		"""
		dsCycles = system.db.runPrepQuery(queryCycles, [startDate, endDate], db)

		# --- Query 2: signatures for those cycles (NO time filter) ---
		querySigs = """
			SELECT
				rh.NodeID, rh.PapoID, rh.WorkstationNodeID, rh.RegisterCode,
				rh.Status, rh.DataAnswer
			FROM registerhistory rh
			WHERE rh.RegisterTypeID = 10
			  AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM registerhistory rh2
				WHERE rh2.NodeID = rh.NodeID
				  AND rh2.PapoID = rh.PapoID
				  AND rh2.WorkstationNodeID = rh.WorkstationNodeID
				  AND rh2.RegisterCode = rh.RegisterCode
				  AND rh2.RegisterTypeID NOT IN (10, 12)
				  AND rh2.Timestamp >= ?
				  AND rh2.Timestamp <= ?
			)
		"""
		dsSigs = system.db.runPrepQuery(querySigs, [startDate, endDate], db)

		# --- Query 3: supervisor name from form data ---
		querySup = """
			SELECT
				rh.NodeID, rh.PapoID, rh.WorkstationNodeID, rh.RegisterCode,
				rh.DataAnswer,
				pi.ID AS SupervisorItemID
			FROM registerhistory rh
			JOIN papo p ON p.ID = rh.PapoID
			JOIN papoitem pi
				ON pi.PapoID = COALESCE(p.MasterPapoID, p.ID)
				AND pi.RegisterTypeID = 7
				AND LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(REPLACE(pi.Description, '.', '')))) = 'supervisor'
			WHERE rh.RegisterTypeID = 7
			  AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM registerhistory rh2
				WHERE rh2.NodeID = rh.NodeID
				  AND rh2.PapoID = rh.PapoID
				  AND rh2.WorkstationNodeID = rh.WorkstationNodeID
				  AND rh2.RegisterCode = rh.RegisterCode
				  AND rh2.RegisterTypeID NOT IN (10, 12)
				  AND rh2.Timestamp >= ?
				  AND rh2.Timestamp <= ?
			)
			ORDER BY rh.ID DESC
		"""
		dsSup = system.db.runPrepQuery(querySup, [startDate, endDate], db)

		# --- Build signature lookup ---
		sigMap = {}
		for i in range(dsSigs.getRowCount()):
			nodeID = dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "NodeID")
			papoID = dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "PapoID")
			wsnID = dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID")
			regCode = dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "RegisterCode")
			sigStatus = (dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "Status") or "").strip().lower()
			raw = dsSigs.getValueAt(i, "DataAnswer")
			key = (nodeID, papoID, wsnID, regCode)

			if key not in sigMap:
				sigMap[key] = {"operador": "", "supervisor": "", "supervisorUser": ""}

			if raw is None or raw == "":
				continue

			try:
				obj = system.util.jsonDecode(raw)
				fullName = (obj.get("name", "") + " " + obj.get("lastname", "")).strip()
				sigUser = obj.get("user", "")
			except:
				continue

			if sigStatus == "finalizado":
				sigMap[key]["operador"] = fullName
			elif sigStatus == "revisado":
				sigMap[key]["supervisor"] = fullName
				sigMap[key]["supervisorUser"] = sigUser

		# --- Build supervisor-from-form lookup ---
		supFromForm = {}
		for i in range(dsSup.getRowCount()):
			nodeID = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "NodeID")
			papoID = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "PapoID")
			wsnID = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID")
			regCode = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "RegisterCode")
			key = (nodeID, papoID, wsnID, regCode)

			# Rows come newest first: keep the latest start-form answer of the cycle
			if key in supFromForm:
				continue

			raw = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "DataAnswer")
			supItemID = dsSup.getValueAt(i, "SupervisorItemID")

			if not raw:
				continue

			try:
				obj = system.util.jsonDecode(raw)
				items = obj.get("items", [])
				for item in items:
					if item.get("papoItemID") == supItemID:
						answer = (item.get("answer") or "").strip()
						if answer and answer != "-":
							supFromForm[key] = answer
						break
			except:
				continue

		# --- Build report list ---
		reportList = []
		for i in range(dsCycles.getRowCount()):
			nodeID = dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "NodeID")
			papoID = dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "PapoID")
			wsnID = dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID")
			regCode = dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "RegisterCode")
			key = (nodeID, papoID, wsnID, regCode)

			sigs = sigMap.get(key, {"operador": "", "supervisor": "", "supervisorUser": ""})
			operador = sigs["operador"] or dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "User") or ""

			# Supervisor esperado: form field > signature > fallback
			formSup = supFromForm.get(key, "")
			if formSup:
				supervisorEsperado = formSup
			elif sigs["supervisor"]:
				supervisorEsperado = sigs["supervisor"]
			else:
				supervisorEsperado = "Sin asignar"

			reportList.append({
				"PapoReference": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "PapoReference"),
				"PapoDescription": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "PapoDescription"),
				"RegisterCode": regCode,
				"NodeName": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "NodeName"),
				"Status": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "Status"),
				"Timestamp": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "Timestamp"),
				"User": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "User"),
				"WorkstationDescription": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationDescription") or "",
				"Operador": operador,
				"Supervisor": sigs["supervisor"],
				"SupervisorUser": sigs["supervisorUser"],
				"SupervisorEsperado": supervisorEsperado,
				"OperadorEsperado": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "User") or "",
				"NodeID": nodeID,
				"PapoID": papoID,
				"Path": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "Path") or "",
				"WorkstationNodeID": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID"),
				"WorkstationID": dsCycles.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationID"),
			})

		# --- Supervisor filter (normalized full name: case and repeated spaces ignored) ---
		def normName(text):
			return " ".join(unicode(text or "").split()).lower()

		# Dropdown options: supervisors with reports in the period (before filtering)
		notANames = set(["", "-", "na", "na na", "no hay supervisores disponibles", "sin asignar"])
		supNames = {}
		for r in reportList:
			name = " ".join(unicode(r["SupervisorEsperado"] or "").split())
			if name.lower() not in notANames:
				supNames.setdefault(name.lower(), name)
		self.view.custom.dataSupervisors = system.dataset.toDataSet(
			["fullName"], [[supNames[k]] for k in sorted(supNames)])

		if supervisorFilter not in (None, "", "null"):
			wanted = normName(supervisorFilter)
			reportList = [r for r in reportList if normName(r["SupervisorEsperado"]) == wanted]

		# --- Counters (over the filtered rows) ---
		totalReportes = len(reportList)
		sinFirmaOp = 0
		sinFirmaSup = 0

		for r in reportList:
			status = (r["Status"] or "").strip().lower()
			operador = (r["Operador"] or "").strip().lower()

			if status == "en proceso" or operador == "cierre automatico":
				sinFirmaOp += 1
			if status == "finalizado":
				sinFirmaSup += 1

		self.view.custom.totalReportes = totalReportes
		self.view.custom.sinFirmaOperario = sinFirmaOp
		self.view.custom.sinFirmaSupervisor = sinFirmaSup

		return reportList

	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error in transform dataReports: " + str(e))
		self.view.custom.totalReportes = 0
		self.view.custom.sinFirmaOperario = 0
		self.view.custom.sinFirmaSupervisor = 0
		return []

logger = system.util.getLogger("transform.path.{}".format(self.view.id))

	def unwrap(v):
		# Perspective quality wrapper (dict or object wrapper) -> raw value
		if v is not None and not isinstance(v, basestring) and hasattr(v, 'get'):
			return v.get('value', '')
		return v

	path = unwrap(value.get('path',''))
	reference = unwrap(value.get('reference',''))
	papoId = unwrap(value.get('papoId',''))
	db = value.get('db','')

	# No row selected yet: keep the default source without logging an error
	if not path or papoId in (None, ''):
		return 'Default'

	try:
		areaPath = '/'.join(path.split('/')[:3])

		query = """
			SELECT p2.Reference
			FROM papo p1
			JOIN papo p2 ON p2.ID = COALESCE(p1.MasterPapoID, p1.ID)
			WHERE p1.ID = ?
		"""
		result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [papoId], db)
		reportReference = result.getValueAt(0, 0) if result.getRowCount() > 0 else reference

		return areaPath+'/'+reportReference

	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error in transform path: " + str(e))
		return 'Default'

if value is None:
		return []

	# Value is the full name: it is what SupervisorEsperado holds
	options = []
	for row in range(value.getRowCount()):
		fullName = value.getValueAt(row, "fullName")
		options.append({"label": fullName, "value": fullName})

	return options

"""
	TablaOperario: reports WITHOUT operator signature (Status = 'En proceso').

	Version: 2.0.0
	Changelog:
		2026-08-31 | Andres G. | v2.0.0 - Case-insensitive status filter
	"""
	if value is None:
		return []

	out = []
	for row in value:
		status = str(row.get("Status", "") or "").strip().lower()
		operador = str(row.get("Operador", "") or "").strip().lower()

		isEnProceso = status == "en proceso"
		isCierreAuto = operador == "cierre automatico"

		if not isEnProceso and not isCierreAuto:
			continue

		rowCells = {}
		for key in row:
			rowCells[key] = {"value": row[key]}
		out.append(rowCells)

	return out
